about: A3: which fields each request asks Caret to fill, labelled by hand from the request alone, for calibrating intent-heads.ts SCOPE_CUTOFF (scripts/ask-scope-eval.ts). Field names are the Ask snapshot's (intent.ts). 'asked' lists the fields the request asks for, or 'all' for every field of the form; 'either' lists fields a careful reader could take either way, which count as neither extra nor missed; every other field is not asked. Set b24 is fixtures/realfill/asks.json word for word. Set dev was written for A3 on the same corpus forms, after the phrasing kinds A1's sets cover (whole form, a part by its heading, a role, named fields, kinds, values, exclusions, relations), without reading the held-out sets (B25, B26, B31-asks). A must-refuse ask is labelled by what it asks for: Caret's refusal is decided after scope, by a veto or by the value.
